candidate_falsified: the pre-GNS Weil functional is integration against a pointwise nonnegative Radon density or positive measure in the explicit-formula u coordinate
source_structure: the prime contribution contains negative atoms -Lambda(n)/sqrt(n) at u=plus/minus log n, while endpoint and archimedean terms are smooth or supported at different loci
singular_support_argument: a smooth distribution cannot cancel the coefficient of an isolated Dirac atom; a positive Radon measure cannot assign negative mass to a singleton
conclusion: the explicit Weil distribution is not itself a positive measure, so no local multiplication-factor square with that measure can prove the restricted quadratic-form positivity
restricted_cone_warning: failure of distributional positivity does not imply failure on the restricted tests exp(-tu^2)(1-exp(-hu^2))|p(exp(-hu^2))|^2
surviving_scope: a nonlocal kernel/operator, quotient-positive form, or positivity mechanism using the restricted test algebra remains possible
acceptance_test: Any surviving factor must act nonlocally or on a quotient/restricted test space and must reproduce the negative prime Dirac coefficients exactly; a pointwise positive u-space density is inadmissible.
